svg.aria-label: ExportMate architecture: browsers reach the Vercel website, which proxies /api/v1 to the backend on Cloud Run in project skilful-scarab and rewrites /api to the AI service on Cloud Run in project exportmate-app. The backend stores data in Cloud SQL and a Cloud Storage documents bucket; the AI service stores data in Firestore, a Cloud Storage bucket and RAG Engine. Both call Vertex AI Gemini and log to Cloud Logging, which feeds metrics, dashboards and email alerts. Two edges are broken: the backend reads an old AI copy, and email to Resend is refused.
